text: Read all five source files (1465 lines) and the call sites in ai-accounts (base.mjs 352-430), ai-runs and ai-use. The listing shows the class's private # members as entries of their own (36 of 81 'anything' lines come from them); they are not interface, so I leave them untyped except where a public method's answer is built by one.

False start: first draft used exact unions for answers that may be refusals ({ok: true, entries} | CatalogueRefusal), for catalogueState's short form, and narrow accepted kinds (kind 'index'|'payload', checksInForce CheckId[]). The check then drew 101 new refusals in the module's own tests (290 total vs 85): the tests read r.code, r.entries, s.seq without narrowing, and pass wrong values on purpose (pullRequest('other'), checksInForce ['P0'], entryOf(undefined)). Redoing: accepted kinds widened to what the code takes and refuses; each answer that may be a refusal becomes one kind with ok: boolean and the members of both outcomes optional.

falseStarts: First draft used exact discriminated unions for answers that may be refusals and for catalogueState's short form, and narrow accepted kinds; the module's own tests read r.code / r.entries / s.seq without narrowing and pass wrong values on purpose, drawing 101 new refusals. Rewrote each such answer as one kind with ok: boolean and the members of both outcomes optional, and widened accepted kinds to what the code takes and refuses.
Typed MOVES as Record<Lifecycle, readonly Lifecycle[]>: the nested Object.freeze does not take the contextual kind; dropped the @type (the inferred kind is already exact in keys).
corrections: ReceiveAnswer.outcome made optional (inherited from PayloadAnswer): the code builds the refused answer through refusal()'s fields, which the reader cannot see carries outcome.
isObj given a type-guard comment so the read methods' `isObj(opts) ? opts : {}` narrows.

timeWentTo.tracing data shapes: about 3 min (validate.mjs is the payload's schema)

notes: After 179 = 100 bounds without a test (expected) + 42 in src (all the reader's guesses about uncommented internals: #view/#pending typed null, sshsig's verify union, validate's ctx object, TextDecoder; down from 65) + 18 in tests that were there before in kind (fixture helpers' defaults, never[]) + 19 in tests caused by honest kinds the tests read without a guard: 14 'Object is possibly null' on entryOf/profileOf/testedOf (code 2531, which the tool does not count as 'cannot tell' though it counts 2533 and 18047), 4 on EntryPrices|Open and CheckAnswer's Open, 1 on warning_version string|null. Listing 'anything': 81 before, 40 after: 38 in the class's private # members (listed as entries by the tool; not interface, left untyped), 2 are my deliberate any (RecordCoreUse.declareTable's answer, SqlStorage rows). Bound lines written: about 100. Wall time is short because reading and writing go fast for me; a person would take far longer on validate.mjs's 578 lines.

falseStarts: Typed seedOf's doc as CataloguePayload: the tests build payloads as loose literals (kind: string), so it drew a refusal; the code reads only seq, schema_version and issued_at, so the parameter now says that.
corrections: SEED_PAYLOAD's @type did not hold through Object.freeze (nested literals widened); replaced by a cast on the literal inside the freeze.

timeWentTo.resolving merge conflicts: about 1 min (two conflicts: the constructor's and aiCatalogueOf's signatures, both lines my comments sit on)

notes: checkRefusalsBefore is the real after state uncommented (96); after with comments 188 = 103 bounds without a test + 85 others (79 at the commented before; the 6 new are in the tests' own fixtures and messages: world()'s untyped seed option, JSON.parse in seed.test). New file seed.mjs copied in and commented (5 comments, 3 new kinds in index.mjs, CatalogueEnv gained two members).
A comment-only change to the provider's code (seed.mjs header) plus a new test. The one new refusal against 194-after is in the new test (world({keys: null}) against the fixture's own default).

timeWentTo.resolving merge conflicts: about 1 min (seed.mjs: my @import beside a new import; catalogueKeysFor's comment rewritten by the change)

notes: The real after state draws 8 rule-34 refusals in dev-key.mjs (process.argv and process.env read without a published start kind) and 4 in the test helper fake-wrangler.mjs. I wrote the two start kinds and wrapped the 8 reads in casts in dev-key.mjs; the test helper I left alone (a test double). After 205 = 108 bounds without a test + 97 others.
